characters.name: Lucia Caminos
characters.summary: Just released from Leonida Penitentiary and determined that every move from here on is a smart one.
body: Lucia learned to fight from her father and has been fighting for her family ever since. That loyalty is what put her inside Leonida Penitentiary, and luck is what got her out.
She wants the good life her mother has dreamed about since their days in Liberty City, and she is done leaving it to chance. Teaming up with Jason looks like her way out.

characters.name: Jason Duval
characters.summary: A former soldier raised among grifters who has slipped back into running drugs in the Leonida Keys.
body: Jason grew up around small-time crooks. A spell in the Army was meant to straighten out a rough adolescence; instead he ended up in the Keys doing what he knows best, working for local drug runners.
He wants an easy life, but things keep getting harder. Meeting Lucia might be the best thing that ever happened to him, or the worst.
ties: Lives rent-free on Brian Heder's property

characters.name: Cal Hampton
characters.summary: Jason's friend, most at ease at home with a few beers and the Coast Guard radio chatter turned up.
body: Cal is Jason's friend and another of Brian Heder's associates. He is happily paranoid, spending his time at home listening in on Coast Guard traffic.
Jason has bigger plans. Cal would rather stay exactly where he is.

characters.name: Boobie Ike
characters.summary: A Vice City legend who turned street reputation into real estate, a strip club and a recording studio.
body: Boobie is one of the few who made the jump from the street to an empire of property, nightlife and a studio. He is all smiles until it is time to talk business.
What he cares about most is Only Raw Records, the label he runs with Dre'Quan Priest. All it needs now is a hit.
Rockstar heads his profile with the line "It's all about heart — the Jack of Hearts." The page does not say what the Jack of Hearts is.
ties: Runs Only Raw Records with Dre'Quan Priest
Backs the label Real Dimez are signed to

characters.name: Dre'Quan Priest
characters.summary: More hustler than gangster. Dealing paid the bills, but music was always the real plan.
body: Dre'Quan sold on the street to get by, with his eye on the music industry the whole time. He books the acts at Boobie Ike's club and runs Only Raw Records alongside him.
Signing Real Dimez could be the break that moves him beyond club bookings.
ties: Runs Only Raw Records with Boobie Ike

characters.name: Real Dimez
characters.summary: Two friends since high school who went from shaking down dealers to rap tracks and a nonstop social feed.
body: Bae-Luxe and Roxy have been friends since school. They turned their time squeezing local dealers into rap tracks and a relentless social media presence.
An early hit with local rapper DWNPLY took them up; five years and a lot of trouble later they are signed to Only Raw Records and hoping for a second one.
ties: Signed to Only Raw Records by Dre'Quan Priest

characters.name: Raul Bautista
characters.summary: A veteran bank robber with charm and patience, always looking for talent willing to take the big risks.
body: Raul has the confidence, charm and cunning of someone who has been robbing banks for a long time, and he is always recruiting.
His recklessness raises the stakes with every score. Sooner or later his crew will have to double down or walk away.

characters.name: Brian Heder
characters.summary: An old-school drug runner from the golden age of Keys smuggling, still moving product through his boat yard.
body: Brian has been around long enough to let other people do his dirty work. He still runs product through the boat yard he keeps with his third wife, Lori.
He lets Jason stay rent-free at one of his properties, on the understanding that Jason helps out with local shakedowns.
ties: Landlord and employer of Jason Duval

locations.name: Vice City
locations.summary: The crowded heart of Leonida, and the series' first return to its Miami stand-in since 2002.
body: Rockstar's own description covers the pastel art deco hotels and white sands of Ocean Beach, the bakeries of Little Cuba, the bootleg brands of the Tisha-Wocka flea market and VC Port, billed as the cruise ship capital of the world.
Other districts named in official material are La Perle, Stockyard, Tequesta and Vice Beach. Rockstar has not published a full district list.

The GTA Wiki's fan-compiled list adds Belville, Crosstown, Downtown, Ekanfinaka, Peacock Bay, Rockridge and Southside. It treats Vice Beach, with Ocean Beach and Washington Beach, as a neighbouring city across the bay, and records two venues, Fleeca Field and Sahara Arena. These are community readings of the trailers and screenshots, not a list from Rockstar.

locations.name: Leonida Keys
locations.summary: The island chain south of Vice City: easy living on some of the most beautiful and dangerous water around. Jason's story starts here.
body: Life in the Keys is not flashy, but it is easy. Official images show divers over coral, party boats, jet skis and a crowded beach bar.
It is also smuggling country. Brian Heder runs his operation from a boat yard here, and Jason works for the local drug runners.

Fans have picked out four island names so far: Key Lento, East Key, Catalan Key and Goose Key. A Leonida Keys road sign appears in the Launch Trailer. The island names are community readings recorded by the GTA Wiki, not a list from Rockstar.

locations.name: Grassrivers
locations.summary: Leonida's vast wetlands, where you never quite know what is under the surface.
body: Grassrivers is swamp, mangroves and open shallow water between the city and the interior. The alligators are the famous attraction, though Rockstar hints at deadlier predators and stranger finds.
Official images show airboats, alligators and a police helicopter chasing a pickup through the swamp.

The GTA Wiki lists Watson Bay as the one town in the wetlands, and suggests the name nods to The Everglades: River of Grass, the 1947 book by Marjory Stoneman Douglas. Both are community notes, not statements from Rockstar.

locations.name: Port Gellhorn
locations.basedOn: Florida's faded Gulf Coast resort towns
locations.summary: A former holiday hotspot that lost its tourists and found a rougher economy to replace them.
body: Port Gellhorn used to be the centre of Leonida's tourist trade. What is left is cheap motels, shut-down attractions and empty strip malls.
The new economy runs on rougher goods, and the local transport of choice is a dirt bike.

locations.name: Ambrosia
locations.summary: Inland Leonida, where the Allied Crystal sugar refinery supplies the jobs and a biker gang supplies the rest.
body: Ambrosia is built around the state's sugar industry, a long way from the coast. The Allied Crystal refinery provides the work.
By Rockstar's account, the local biker gang provides almost everything else.

locations.name: Mount Kalaga National Park
locations.basedOn: Florida's state forests and hill country
locations.summary: Forest, high ground and backwoods against the northern border: the closest Leonida gets to wilderness.
body: Mount Kalaga is a national landmark at the top of the map, pitched for its hunting, fishing and off-road trails.
The backwoods around it are home to people who want to live well away from the government. Official images show dirt bikes, an ATV, hunters, a cougar stalking deer and a kayaker.

vehicles.name: Classic Cars
vehicles.summary: Old American metal, restored and rebuilt. Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshots show the Vapid Ganado Retro Build, a low-riding pickup.
body: The Vapid Ganado Retro Build is named and pictured in Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshots. Its in-game class and performance have not been published.

vehicles.name: Sports Cars
vehicles.summary: Low, wide and fast. Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshots show the '95 Grotti Cheetah.
body: The '95 Grotti Cheetah is named and pictured in Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshots. Its in-game class and performance have not been published.

vehicles.name: Boats
vehicles.summary: From Brian Heder's boat yard to the party boats of the Keys, Leonida lives on the water.
body: Official images of the Leonida Keys show a raft of party boats. Brian Heder moves product through a boat yard there.

vehicles.name: Airboats
vehicles.summary: Flat-bottomed and fan-driven, the way across Grassrivers.
body: Airboats appear in Rockstar's Grassrivers images, and airboating was among the activities in the Extended Look.

vehicles.name: Pickups, Dirt Bikes and ATVs
vehicles.summary: Mud-ready machines for the backwoods, from Port Gellhorn to Mount Kalaga.
body: Official images show dirt bikes and an ATV in the mud at Mount Kalaga and a pickup being chased through Grassrivers. Rockstar's Port Gellhorn text tells you to jump on a dirt bike.

vehicles.name: '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy
vehicles.summary: An off-road buggy included with the Ultimate Edition, pitched for the backwoods of Mount Kalaga.
body: Rockstar's Ultimate Edition description presents it as a Mud Club vehicle with strong off-road handling.
It can be kept at the Paradise Garage in Watson Bay, which Rockstar says has a weapon locker and somewhere to drop off stolen goods for fencing.

vehicles.name: Planes and Helicopters
vehicles.summary: Seaplanes over the Keys and helicopters over everything.
body: Official images show a seaplane over the Leonida Keys, a police helicopter over Grassrivers and a news helicopter over Mount Kalaga.

vehicles.name: Jet Skis and Kayaks
vehicles.summary: Small craft for the Keys and the rivers of the north.
body: Jet skis and kayaking were both shown in the Extended Look. Official images show jet skis in the Keys and a kayaker at Mount Kalaga.

gameplay.name: Switching between Jason and Lucia
gameplay.summary: Control passes between the two leads through most of the game: instantly when they are together, after a few seconds when apart.
body: The lead you are not playing acts on their own and can be called by phone. Some story sequences lock the swap. This is what the Extended Look footage showed; Rockstar has not described it in writing.
TGG reports that each lead has their own stats and their own criminal profile, and that Nelson described checking in with the other lead and switching when they are available.

gameplay.name: Six-star wanted level
gameplay.summary: Six stars are back. Police react to what is witnessed or caught on camera, and track your description, clothes and vehicle separately.
body: Changing clothes or vehicle, or covering your face beforehand, changes how long the heat lasts. Shown in the Extended Look, not published as a feature list.
TGG, who attended Rockstar's preview, reports that Rob Nelson told him a six-star search covers the whole map, and that Rockstar would not say what else six stars brings.

Other details from his November 2026 guide: stars flash white once you break the line of sight; police set up a perimeter outside a store you have just robbed; a respray removes the description of your car; and hiding underwater works better in deep or murky water. He relays Edge magazine's preview of a police dog pinning Jason after a spike strip stopped his motorbike.

gameplay.name: Combat
gameplay.summary: Enemies can be wounded or disarmed rather than killed, and heavy hits pull the camera into slow motion.
body: Shown in the Extended Look. Rockstar has not published written detail.
For what previews have since reported about carrying weapons, Focus and hand-to-hand fighting, see the separate entries in this category.

gameplay.name: Stealing cars
gameplay.summary: From breaking a window to working the lock with a slim jim; better cars carry electronic locks, alarms and trackers.
body: A phone app scans a car first and reports what it is worth and how it is protected. Shown in the Extended Look.

TGG reports that a driver can resist being pulled out, as a quick-time interaction, and that he watched a passenger throw Nelson back out. A slim jim, worked with the analog sticks, opens older cars quietly.

Some cars cannot be hot-wired at all and need a key cloner. The scanner app shows a car's security level, the tool it needs, its tracker, its resale value and the cost of registering it. A high-end tracker beeps faster and faster if you slow down, then alerts the police.

gameplay.name: Robberies
gameplay.summary: Robberies trade speed against take: forcing a safe is quicker but damages what is inside.
body: There are second exits for when the front door stops being an option. Shown in the Extended Look.

TGG reports that Nelson told him any store you walk into can be robbed, whether or not it shows a robbery icon. Bigger targets can show their potential take on the map. A safe's code may be texted by a fence or found in the store; blowing it open damages the loot.

Customers and staff may rush you, grab for your gun or draw their own. Camera recordings can be destroyed so you are not identified, though he relays another preview of a shop that kept its footage in the cloud. How many duffel bags you can take depends on the vehicle you brought.

activities.name: Racing
activities.summary: Races on tarmac and on dirt both appeared in the Extended Look.
body: TGG's November 2026 guide points out three kinds in the Extended Look: a circuit race with a lap counter and position, a street race at night in which nitrous is used, and an off-road race with bikes and cars together.

activities.name: Water sports
activities.summary: Jet skis, kayaking and diving were all shown, with the Keys as the natural home for them.
body: TGG notes that scuba diving has an oxygen meter.

activities.name: Sports and leisure
activities.summary: The gym, basketball, pool, mini golf and parachuting all appeared in the Extended Look, along with nightclubs.

activities.name: Hunting, fishing and off-roading
activities.summary: Rockstar pitches Mount Kalaga National Park for its hunting, fishing and off-road trails.
body: TGG reports that Rob Nelson told him fishing is catch and release, with challenges, collectibles and some story content tied to it, and that hunting can earn money through a character who knows Jason.

activities.name: Everyday life
activities.summary: Petting a dog, watching television, shopping, and a phone the character actually holds.

wildlife.name: Alligators
wildlife.summary: The most famous attraction in Grassrivers, by Rockstar's own description.

wildlife.name: Cougars
wildlife.summary: An official Mount Kalaga image shows a cougar stalking deer at a stream. A wildcat also appears in a Grassrivers image.

wildlife.name: Deer
wildlife.summary: Seen at a stream in Mount Kalaga National Park in an official image.

wildlife.name: Sea turtles
wildlife.summary: An official Leonida Keys image shows divers among coral with a sea turtle.

wildlife.name: Dogs
wildlife.summary: Dogs can be petted, as shown in the Extended Look.

businesses.name: Only Raw Records
businesses.summary: The Vice City record label run by Boobie Ike and Dre'Quan Priest. Real Dimez are signed to it.

businesses.name: Allied Crystal sugar refinery
businesses.summary: Ambrosia's sugar refinery and the source of the town's jobs.

businesses.name: Tisha-Wocka flea market
businesses.summary: A flea market known, in Rockstar's words, for its bootleg brands.

businesses.name: Brian Heder's boat yard
businesses.summary: The Keys boat yard Brian runs with his wife Lori, and the front for his smuggling.

businesses.name: Fleeca bank

factions.summary: The bank robbery crew Raul leads. Rockstar has not named anyone else in it.

factions.name: Ambrosia biker gang
factions.summary: An unnamed biker gang that, by Rockstar's account, runs almost everything in Ambrosia the refinery does not.

factions.name: Keys drug runners
factions.summary: The smuggling trade of the Leonida Keys, where Jason works and Brian Heder is the old guard.

music.name: Original score by Justice
music.summary: The electronic duo Justice composed the game's score. A 30-track album is due on December 11, 2026.
body: Singles so far are "Flower in a Hurricane" and "Pusher". The Launch Trailer is set to new music from the duo.
Justice are the French duo Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay. Rockstar calls the score adaptive: it changes with how you play.
"Flower in a Hurricane" features Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. "Pusher" features Gesaffelstein.
The album comes to streaming services, CD and vinyl. Rockstar's shop lists a limited triple crystal clear vinyl and a double CD.
Apple Music's pre-release listing shows 50 tracks, dated December 11, 2026. Rockstar says the album has 30 tracks plus a number of digital bonus tracks.
Only two titles are shown so far: Pusher is track 18 and Flower In A Hurricane is track 36. The other 48 are untitled placeholders.
Apple Music credits the release to Take-Two Interactive Software under exclusive licence to Ed Banger Records and Because Music.

music.name: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album
music.summary: The official soundtrack album: 34 original tracks made with Atlantic Records, out with the game on November 19, 2026.
body: Rockstar's music page lists ten singles: "That's It" by Yung Lean (featuring Future and Metro Boomin); "RHYNO" by Travis Scott; "Sexy Magic" by CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. and Etienne de Crécy; "Flower in a Hurricane" by Justice; "Last Thing You Need" by Morgan Wallen; "Suzuki" by Fuerza Regida; "Macacoa 2000" by Rauw Alejandro; "Don't Chart" by Cardi B; "Blood In Your Eyes" by Tove Lo; and "Bright Lights, Big City" by Keith Richards.
Rockstar's shop lists the album on an exclusive vinyl and a standard vinyl.
Apple Music now lists all 34 tracks; the full running order is in the entry Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album track list.

Tracks not among the ten singles include Go Easy by Dua Lipa, Crazy For You by Lana Del Rey, Power Trip by JENNIE, Fast Emotion by Zara Larsson, Sweet Like Candy by Camila Cabello and Bigger by Burna Boy.
Apple Music's New Zealand store dates the album November 20, 2026, one day after the date on Rockstar's music page.

music.name: Radio stations and podcasts
music.summary: Rockstar has named six radio stations and confirmed on-demand podcasts, plus radio on foot through headphones.
body: The six are Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics. Each has its own entry in this category, with its genre and hosts.
Rockstar's music page also mentions stations for classic rock and talk radio, without naming them, and says the game has the series' widest selection of radio and podcasts.

With the game out, GameSpot and CULTR each count 22 stations: the six Rockstar named plus Emotion 98.3, Vice City FM, V-Rock, Stockyard FM, VCRR, Honey FM, Radio La Ola, Radio On-U, Gloriana Blues Radio, Leonida Jazz Radio, Symphony FM, Worldwide FM, CircoLoco Records Radio, Kaleidoscope FM, and the talk stations WKTT and The Wipe.
The Big Lead says 23, though its own table has 22 rows, counting the unlockable Vault Radio and leaving out CircoLoco Records Radio. Adding The Vault Radio to GameSpot's 22 also gives 23.
GameSpot calls it the most stations in any Grand Theft Auto game.
None of the three outlets names an individual podcast.

music.name: Trailer 1 song
music.summary: The reveal trailer was set to Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road".

editions.name: Standard Edition
editions.summary: The base game on PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X|S.
body: Pre-orders include the Vintage Vice City Pack: the '55 Vapid Stanier with a garage by Ocean Beach, outfits and hairstyles for Jason and Lucia, and a weapon pattern.
A digital pre-order on either console includes one month of GTA+. PlayStation's page adds that it can be claimed until March 31 and renews as a paid subscription unless cancelled.
The boxed version holds a download code and no disc. The Vintage Vice City Pack comes with pre-orders and with purchases made before November 20, 2026.

editions.name: Ultimate Edition
editions.summary: The game plus an exclusive collection of items tied to Jason and Lucia's story.
body: Rockstar lists vehicles (among them the '95 Grotti Cheetah, '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy and Shitzu Squalo), the Hawk & Little Morgan Revolvers, personalized pistols, four shops that open only with this edition, a gang raid and a car-collecting commission. Each has its own entry.

PlayStation's page groups the extras as vehicles and garages, weapons, looks, and a special commission and customs. Two of Rockstar's Ultimate Edition screenshot sets are titled "Vice City Style" and "Goodtime Gear".

The PlayStation Store also lists an Ultimate Edition Upgrade as a separate add-on. A digital pre-order on either console includes one month of GTA+. PlayStation's page adds that it can be claimed until March 31 and renews as a paid subscription unless cancelled.
There is no boxed Ultimate Edition. Standard Edition owners, boxed or digital, can buy the Ultimate Edition Upgrade from the PlayStation or Microsoft store once their copy is redeemed.

news.name: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival
news.summary: A live launch event at Mana Wynwood in Miami, with two stages of artists from the game and its soundtrack.
body: Announced by Rockstar on November 9, presented with PlayStation and produced by the creators of III Points. The announced performers include Travis Scott, Don Toliver, Kodak Black and Sofaygo (as Cactus Jack), Cardi B, Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso, Justice (DJ set), Metro Boomin and Tainy.
Tickets went through a pre-sale lottery that closed on November 10, limited to two per code.

news.name: Rockstar Support adds its first in-game help articles
news.summary: Rockstar's support site added launch articles on BuckMe account limits, the settings menu and console error codes.
body: Cannot put any more money in my BuckMe account in Grand Theft Auto VI (last updated November 19): limits on the BuckMe Checking and Family Savings accounts rise as the main story progresses, and payments held up by a full Checking account go through once it is upgraded.

How to change Grand Theft Auto VI settings (November 18): Settings is in the Pause Menu, with the categories Control Scheme, Controller, Gameplay, Display, UI, Camera, Audio and Account, and Restore All or Restore Default options.
Grand Theft Auto VI Error Troubleshooting (November 18): it points to PlayStation's and Xbox's own error-code pages.

Grand Theft Auto VI Platforms, Editions, and Versions was updated on November 18. It says the game will be available through Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One consoles using Xbox Series S graphics settings, and fully supports Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox.
No known-issues list or title update notes had been posted when the site was read.

news.name: Launch day
news.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI releases on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar's support site gives the time as midnight local time in every region.
body: New Zealand reached midnight first, at 11:00 UTC on November 18, and the release follows the clock west from there.

news.name: Australia's broadband network sets a traffic record on launch night
news.summary: ABC News reports Australia's National Broadband Network moved a record 36.54 terabits per second on the night of the launch.
body: An NBN spokesperson told ABC News that traffic on the night of November 18 and early November 19 peaked at 36.54 terabits per second, about 20 percent above normal and above the record set on November 12.
ABC News reports the game went live in Australia just after midnight AEDT and that some fans set their consoles to New Zealand time to start hours early.
ABC News also quotes a former Good Game Spawn Point host, Angharad Yeo, saying Rockstar had reportedly taken about US$1.5 billion in pre-sales; that is a reported figure, not one from Take-Two.

news.name: Rockstar gives the resolution on each console
news.summary: In a statement reported by VGC, Rockstar says PlayStation 5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X start from 1440p and output 4K, while Xbox Series S starts from 720p and outputs 1080p.
body: VGC reports a joint statement given to Wccftech by Rockstar's senior vice president of technology Jonathon Ashcroft, technical director Chris Oat and technology production director Marc Chambers.

As VGC quotes it, the statement says PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X upscale a base resolution of 1440p to 4K with Rockstar's own TAA, PlayStation 5 Pro uses PSSR2 to upscale 1440p to 4K, and Xbox Series S upscales 720p to 1080p with AMD FSR.
The statement says the team decided early on to target 30 frames per second on this generation of consoles and that input latency is much improved over Grand Theft Auto V and Red Dead Redemption 2.
VGC's headline calls the Series S upscaler FSR 4.1, while the quoted statement says FSR Upscaling 4. VGC says it seems to be the first Series S game to use the new AMD upscaling.

VGC also cites Digital Foundry's view that the Series S version looks close in broad strokes to Series X but has frame-rate problems, with Digital Foundry advising players to use other consoles for now.

news.name: Rockstar explains why darts and bowling are missing
news.summary: Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson told VGC the team left out darts because it could not make it good enough in the time it had.
body: Nelson told VGC that even Rockstar does not have unlimited money or time, and that darts was one activity the team did not get to.

He said that since Red Dead Redemption 2, Rockstar treats minigames as activities that must feel like an extension of the game's mechanics, giving pool with proper physics, weightlifting and basketball shooting as examples.
VGC notes darts was in the previous two Grand Theft Auto games and GTA Online, and bowling in Grand Theft Auto IV.

news.name: Sony and Microsoft shares rise with the launch
news.summary: Stocktwits reports Sony closed nearly 3 percent higher in Tokyo on launch day and Sensor Tower still estimated over 17 million copies and $1.65 billion as of Thursday morning.
body: As Stocktwits reports it, Sensor Tower estimated over 17 million copies sold worldwide and $1.65 billion in sales as of the morning of Thursday, November 19, with PlayStation about three quarters of sales. These are Sensor Tower estimates, not Take-Two figures.

Stocktwits reports Take-Two shares up 1 percent in pre-market trading on November 19 after a gain of over 6 percent the day before, Microsoft up 1.6 percent, Sony closing nearly 3 percent higher in Tokyo, and AMD up 3 percent before the market opened.

news.name: A second PlayStation Network outage as the US launch begins
news.summary: PlayStation Network had a second short disruption early on November 19, around the time the game unlocked in the eastern United States. Both outages are over, and Sony has not said what caused them.
body: TechRepublic reports two PSN disruptions, one on November 18 and one on November 19. It cites the outage monitor IsDown, which logged about 24 minutes of degraded Gaming and Social services, game streaming included, from 5:34 a.m. UTC on November 19, and a 32-minute disruption on November 18. TechRepublic adds that IsDown's monitored windows may not cover every player's connection trouble.

Digit gives an Indian-time timeline for the US launch. Reports on Downdetector rose from about 10:20 a.m. IST, the game unlocked in the US at 10:30 a.m. IST, and reports peaked at more than 8,900 around 10:40 a.m. IST. They were mostly from the United States and were about server connections, sign-in and downloads. Digit quotes PlayStation's status page as warning that players might have trouble launching games, apps or network features while a fix was worked on. 10:30 a.m. IST is midnight US Eastern time.

The reports do not agree. Neowin wrote that users reported several hours of problems that eased after about half an hour of rising reports, and that Sony's status site showed no issues when it looked. For the November 18 outage, TechRepublic cites CT Insider as counting more than 1,800 Downdetector complaints at one point. Downdetector numbers are reports sent in by users, not a count of affected accounts.

Sony has not said whether GTA VI traffic caused either outage. TechRepublic says a player who still cannot start the game while PSN is working may have a download, account or licence problem, and points to the Restore Licenses option under Settings > Users and Accounts > Other on PS5.

news.name: The Japanese release is toned down
news.summary: Kotaku reports that Japanese players found less nudity and blood in their copy of the game, and fewer languages. Rockstar had not confirmed any changes before release.
body: Kotaku says the Japanese version adds clothing to nudity throughout the game. Characters shower in underwear, some scenes are changed and others are removed. There is also less blood, and it fades sooner, judging by streams from Japanese creators. Strip clubs and in-game drug use are still in.
According to Kotaku, the Japanese version has only English and Japanese subtitles with the English voice track, and copies sold elsewhere do not include Japanese subtitles.

Before launch, players had noticed that the Japanese pre-load was over 1 GB smaller and that the rating from CERO, Japan's ratings board, did not mention the sexual content listed in most other countries. Kotaku says Rockstar confirmed no changes before release, so players only learned of the cuts once they started playing.
Kotaku also repeats that in Japan the download code in the boxed version must be redeemed within 170 days of release.

news.name: GameStop's chief executive criticises digital-only releases
news.summary: On launch day, GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen told Bloomberg that the move to all-digital games has hurt consumers and his company. GameStop still sells the boxed version, which holds a download code.
body: As Kotaku reports from the Bloomberg interview, Cohen said people should be able to sell, trade or lend games they buy. He did not name GTA VI.
He also told Bloomberg that the boxed edition is a code in a box and that GameStop is selling a lot of it. On November 17 he had posted on X asking who still wanted a physical copy of GTA.
Kotaku notes that pre-owned games and refurbished tech made up 22 percent of GameStop's revenue in the quarter ending August 1.

news.name: GTA VI takes over the PS5 Welcome hub
news.summary: Push Square reports that the PS5's Welcome hub now promotes the game and offers five new GTA VI wallpapers.
body: Push Square says the Welcome hub icon now has a pink and orange gradient with palm trees. A promotional panel at the top opens the game's PlayStation Store page and can be dismissed.
Further down the hub there is a new GTA VI backgrounds folder with five wallpapers in the game's illustrated style. Most show Jason and Lucia.
Push Square quotes no statement from Sony or Rockstar about it.

news.name: Take-Two's launch-day press release
news.summary: Take-Two and Rockstar issued a press release on November 19 announcing the game is out on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, calling it the highest rated game of all time on those consoles.
body: The release went out on Business Wire from New York and is listed first on Take-Two's press-release page. Its subtitle says the game launches as the highest rated game of all time on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

It carries a new statement from Sam Houser, Rockstar's president and founder: in short, that the game represents everything Rockstar has worked towards since it began, that he hopes it goes beyond what players expect from the medium, and that Rockstar is grateful for the support. This is different wording from the statement he gave GamesRadar+ the day before.
It quotes short lines from reviews by The New York Times (a Critic's Pick), The Washington Post, Bloomberg, IGN, Eurogamer, The Guardian and Polygon.
It says Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, from Atlantic Records, has 34 original tracks and is out at midnight on streaming services, with vinyl and CD at gtavi-thealbum.com.
The game is listed as sold through the PlayStation Store, Microsoft Store, Rockstar Games Store and retailers, and rated M by the ESRB.

The company background gives these Take-Two figures: Grand Theft Auto V has sold in nearly 235 million units, the series nearly 480 million, and Red Dead Redemption nearly 118 million. 'Sold in' means copies shipped to stores, not copies bought by players.

The release gives no sales or player numbers for Grand Theft Auto VI. IGN's live blog points out that the score is a joint record across all platforms: on Metacritic the game shares 99 with the Nintendo 64 Ocarina of Time.

news.name: Rockstar posts the full credits online
news.summary: Rockstar has put the game's complete credits on its website, searchable, with every department, the main cast, and a long list of former employees.
body: The page at rockstargames.com/VI/credits has sections for Writing, Audio, Game Design, Development Production, Performance Production, Animation, Technology, Art, Platform Services, Quality Assurance, Publishing, Cast, GTA Media, outsourced services, Street Art and Tattoos, and Special Thanks. A separate list is headed Former Employees.

It is headed by Sam Houser (Founder, Executive Producer), Jennifer Kolbe (Head of Publishing), Rob Nelson and Aaron Garbut (both Head of Development / Co-Studio Head), Phil Hooker (Head of Development) and Chris Choi (Senior Vice President of Development).

Other department heads named include Rupert Humphries (Senior Vice President of Narrative), Stephen Donkin (Vice President of Design), Jonathon Ashcroft (Senior Vice President of Technology), Alastair MacGregor (Vice President of Audio) and Jeff Rosa (Vice President of Quality Assurance).
The GTA TV and radio writing directors are DJ Pooh and Joey Henson, and the additional writers include "Weird Al" Yankovic.
The main cast list names Dylan Rourke as Jason Duval and Manni L. Perez as Lucia Caminos. Eurogamer says the credits went up on November 19; Rockstar's page shows no date.

news.name: Dylan Rourke is named as Jason
news.summary: Rockstar's published credits list Dylan Rourke as the actor playing Jason Duval, and a photo of him with Manni L. Perez appeared the same day.
body: Rockstar's credits page lists Dylan Rourke against Jason Duval at the top of the main cast, followed by Manni L. Perez as Lucia Caminos.

IGN reports that Lucia's main stunt double, Victoria Lee, posted a photo on Instagram on November 19 of herself with Rourke and Perez in front of a Grand Theft Auto VI billboard. IGN calls it the first public confirmation of Rourke in the role, and says his name had been going around online for the previous day.
IGN describes Rourke as an actor with guest roles in TV series including Modern Family and Grey's Anatomy.
The same cast list confirms Stephen Root as Brian Heder and names other actors, including Bobby Moynihan as Cal and Manny Perez as Raul Bautista.

news.name: All 34 fired Rockstar staff appear in the credits
news.summary: Eurogamer reports that all 34 Rockstar employees fired in 2025 are named in the game's credits, six of them under their old departments rather than as former employees.
body: Eurogamer checked a list of 34 names supplied by the Independent Workers Union of Great Britain, the union bringing the tribunal case. On November 18 it had matched at least 28; after Rockstar put the credits online in searchable form on November 19 it confirmed all 34.
Eurogamer says six of the names are not in the Former Employees list but under the departments those people worked in, as if they still worked at Rockstar. It does not know why and says it is asking.
Eurogamer did not publish the names, for privacy reasons.

The numbers disagree: Eurogamer, citing the union's list, says 34 were fired, while the Guardian piece by a Rockstar programmer that this app already cites gives 31 union members. Both are reported here.
Eurogamer also repeats Rockstar's earlier figure of more than 4,711 people across 12 offices working on the game.

news.name: IGN: about 20 million pre-orders likely by launch
news.summary: IGN works out from Sensor Tower's data that pre-orders probably reached about 20 million before release. That is an extrapolation, not a company figure.
body: IGN says Sensor Tower counted 17.07 million copies by November 16, with pre-orders then averaging more than a million a day, which makes 20 million a likely total by launch. Sensor Tower is not quoted giving 20 million itself.
The dates disagree: IGN dates Sensor Tower's 17.07 million to November 16, while GameSpot and Reuters, as this app already records, gave about 17 million as of November 18.
IGN puts Sensor Tower's revenue estimate above $1.6 billion, split about 75 percent PlayStation 5 and 25 percent Xbox Series X|S.

IGN describes Take-Two shares rising about 6 percent from a low of $203 on November 17 to a high of $222 at the close on November 18. Fox Business, as already recorded, gave the November 18 close as $216.61; the figures do not match.
Rockstar and Take-Two had published no pre-order or sales numbers when IGN wrote, and the launch press release gives none either.

news.name: Xbox puts the game's artwork on every dashboard
news.summary: Xbox consoles replaced players' own backgrounds with GTA VI artwork through a feature called Event Backgrounds, which can be switched off. Microsoft is now asking for feedback on it.
body: IGN reports that the feature, which is on by default, shows artwork of Jason and Lucia in place of the player's chosen theme. It says Microsoft did the same with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 the month before.
To switch it off, IGN gives Settings, Personalisation, My Background, then untick Show Event-themed Background. One player quoted by IGN said the option had turned itself back on.
IGN says a new Xbox Feedback poll asks players what they think of Event Backgrounds and how often they should be used.

Eurogamer notes that Xbox's own launch-week posts, such as How to Get Ready for November 19, never name the game. Its guess is that PlayStation's marketing deal with Rockstar stops other consoles using the name in advertising. That is Eurogamer's reading, not a confirmed term. Xbox Wire does name the game in factual posts, such as the one on cloud streaming.

news.name: Restaurant chains mark launch day
news.summary: Popeyes, KFC, Subway and Burger King ran launch-week food promotions themed on the game. The reports describe the KFC and Burger King ones as unofficial.
body: Popeyes (US): a limited Spice City Sandwich, two chicken fillets on a brioche bun, sold November 19 to 22 in restaurants, in the app and for delivery, according to Nation's Restaurant News. The report does not say whether Rockstar is involved.

KFC (UK): Dexerto reports a London competition in which winners got meals delivered on November 19 by a pink 1959 Cadillac branded Cluck n' Bell, a nod to the series' Cluckin' Bell. Dexerto says it is not an official Rockstar collaboration. It also reports free UK delivery through Just Eat from 6 p.m. on November 19, subject to confirmation, and a mock funeral with free chicken at KFC in Robina, Queensland, the same day.

Subway (Miami only): the Cubano Pulled Pork Melt renamed the Vice City Cubano, as Dexerto reports. Dexerto credits the image to Subway and Rockstar Games but does not say whether Rockstar approved it.

Burger King (Belgium): a seven-patty HeartWhopper, a real version of the series' Heart Stopper burger from Burger Shot. IGN says it is not sold on the menu. It is a prize in a two-week social-media competition, and IGN's live blog calls it a parody rather than an official collaboration.
This is separate from KFC Spain's disc-shaped chicken and the Skinny Louie Burger Shot restaurants, which the reports mention as other promotions.

news.name: The Album's full track list appears on Apple Music
news.summary: Apple Music's listing for Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album now shows all 34 tracks, including new songs by Dua Lipa, Lana Del Rey, JENNIE and Burna Boy.
body: The album opens with Starting From Zero by Justice featuring Michael McDonald and closes with Overtown Lights by Stanley Clarke, Robert Glasper and Yussef Dayes.
Rockstar's own music page still names only the ten singles. Apple Music's New Zealand store dates the album November 20; Rockstar says November 19.

news.name: Players find 22 radio stations
news.summary: GameSpot and CULTR each count 22 radio stations in the released game, sixteen more than the six Rockstar named, plus the unlockable Vault Radio.
body: Returning names include V-Rock and Emotion 98.3 from Vice City, WKTT from Grand Theft Auto IV and Worldwide FM from Grand Theft Auto V.
GameSpot reports the actor Jeremy Irons hosts Kaleidoscope FM, a station of foreign-language covers; Rockstar's Ivan Pavlovich confirmed the casting to GameSpot.
The Big Lead gives the total as 23.

news.name: Sensor Tower estimates 17 million copies sold before launch
news.summary: The analytics firm Sensor Tower estimates 17.07 million pre-purchases worth about $1.65 billion; this is an outside estimate, not a Take-Two figure.
body: As GameSpot reports Sensor Tower's tracker: 12.73 million on PlayStation 5 (about $1.23 billion) and 4.35 million on Xbox Series X|S (about $419 million), roughly a 75 to 25 split.
Sensor Tower projects as many as 25 million pre-purchases by launch. That is a projection.
Reuters carried the same estimate: some 17 million copies for more than $1.65 billion as of Wednesday, November 18.
GameSpot also cites Circana: 29 percent of US console and PC players intend to buy the game, the highest purchase intent Circana has measured.
Take-Two and Rockstar had published no sales figure when this was read.

news.name: Sam Houser issues a launch statement
news.summary: Rockstar co-founder Sam Houser gave GamesRadar a rare statement for launch, saying he hopes the game feels both familiar and entirely new.
body: As GameSpot reports it, Houser said Rockstar was founded on the belief that games could stand alongside other forms of storytelling, and that the player shapes how the story feels and ends.
He added that Rockstar looks forward to many more years of sharing such experiences.

news.name: Take-Two shares jump after the reviews
news.summary: GameSpot reports Take-Two shares rose nearly 7 percent in pre-market trading on November 18 and climbed further during the day.
body: GameSpot adds that the stock was still down close to 20 percent for 2026 and about 15 percent over twelve months, with a 52-week high of $265.65 and low of $183.86.
Reuters also reported the shares rising in pre-market trading.

news.name: A brief PlayStation Network problem on launch eve
news.summary: GameSpot reports a temporary PlayStation Network problem with launching games on November 18 that was then fixed, while Sony's status page showed no fault.

news.name: Reviews arrive: 99 on Metacritic
news.summary: Reviews were published the day before launch. Metacritic shows a score of 99 from 147 PlayStation 5 reviews, with none mixed or negative.
body: The figures are Metacritic's own page as read on November 18 and will move as more reviews are added. Its Xbox Series X page shows 99 from 14 reviews.

Two of the reviews were read in full for this app: TheSixthAxis gave it 9 out of 10 and Push Square 10 out of 10. What they report about how the game plays is in the Encyclopedia under Gameplay, marked as spoilers.

news.name: Out first in New Zealand
news.summary: The game unlocked at midnight on November 19 in New Zealand, the first country to reach launch day. That was 11:00 UTC on November 18, or 6 a.m. Eastern in the United States.
body: Because the release is midnight local time everywhere, it rolls west hour by hour: Sydney and Melbourne two hours after New Zealand, Japan and South Korea four hours after, most of western Europe twelve, the United Kingdom thirteen, and the United States Eastern time zone eighteen.

This is BNO News's report of the rollout, not a Rockstar statement. It notes that some United States storefronts are reported to unlock the whole country at midnight Eastern, which would be 9 p.m. Pacific on November 18; check your own store page.

news.name: The biggest game launch ever on streaming sites
news.summary: Streams Charts counted a preliminary peak of about 7.89 million people watching the game live across Twitch, YouTube and Kick as the rollout began, about four and a half times the previous launch record.
body: Streams Charts gives the preliminary peak as 7,886,176 concurrent viewers on November 18: about 3.29 million on Twitch, 3.19 million on YouTube and 1.50 million on Kick. It says the figures could still change as the rollout continues.
Streams Charts says the previous launch record was Valorant's closed beta in April 2020, at 1,737,267 peak viewers, followed by Hogwarts Legacy at 1,363,939.
By Streams Charts' count the Twitch peak puts the game ahead of League of Legends (3.11 million) and Fortnite (3.04 million), and more than 200 streamers beat their own all-time viewer records.
Earlier in the evening Kotaku, citing Streams Charts, reported about 5.8 million viewers in total, with over 2.8 million on Twitch; the higher figure came later as more countries reached launch.

news.name: Analysts raise their sales forecasts; no official figure yet
news.summary: Reuters reports that Wells Fargo now expects about 65 million copies sold by the end of March and Oppenheimer about $1.85 billion in the first three days; Take-Two has not published a sales figure.
body: As Reuters reports it (carried by CNBC), Wells Fargo raised its forecast to about 65 million units in Take-Two's fiscal year to March, up from 35 million, partly on the expectation of a possible PC release early in 2027, and raised its yearly bookings estimate by 19 percent to $9.76 billion.
The same report compares that with Take-Two's own guidance of $8 billion to $8.2 billion and an LSEG analyst consensus of $8 billion.
Reuters also reports that Oppenheimer estimates about $1.85 billion in gross revenue over the first three days, against about $1 billion for Grand Theft Auto V's first three days in 2013.

Sensor Tower's tracker showed roughly 17.1 million copies sold as of midday Eastern time on November 18, according to Reuters. GamesRadar+ earlier cited a lower Sensor Tower figure of $1.45 billion; both are outside estimates, not company numbers.
Fox Business reports Take-Two shares closed up more than 6 percent at $216.61 on November 18; Benzinga gives the close as $216.71, up 6.22 percent, with a further 2.72 percent gain after hours.
Benzinga reports that the betting site Polymarket gave a 99 percent chance that first-day revenue would beat Grand Theft Auto V's $815.7 million record. That is a betting market, not sales data.
Take-Two's press release page showed no launch or sales announcement when it was read, and Fox Business said Take-Two could not be reached for comment.

news.name: Rockstar developers celebrate the reviews
news.summary: GamesRadar+ collected posts from Rockstar staff reacting to the reviews, including a senior environment artist who said he felt like a kid on Christmas morning.
body: GamesRadar+ reports that senior environment artist Jonathon Gregory Bick wrote that he had worked on the game for almost eight years and was proud of what the team achieved.
It also quotes associate lead programmer Allan Walton, production coordinator Navya Manaswitha and a senior QA tester, each thanking the team and saying they were glad the game was out.

news.name: Rockstar explains a missing series feature
news.summary: Kotaku reports the game has no hireable street sex workers, a feature in every main Grand Theft Auto since III, and quotes Rockstar's explanation to Shacknews.
body: Rockstar told Shacknews, as Kotaku quotes it, that the game is about a couple on the run and that everything in it was chosen to support that story and systems such as the wanted level, radio, robberies and car theft.
Kotaku notes that strip clubs remain in the game.

news.name: The Miami Heat become the Vice City Heat for one night
news.summary: On launch eve the Miami Heat played the Milwaukee Bucks in Vice City uniforms, and Kotaku reports the themed merchandise sold out in about 90 minutes.
body: Siliconera reported in October that the Heat announced a Grand Theft Auto VI night at Kaseya Center on November 18 against the Bucks, with Vice City uniforms, a themed court and merchandise.

Kotaku reports, citing reporters at the arena, that crowds lined up for $120 Vice City jerseys, that the broadcast opened with a custom intro, and that Macca the Gator, a mascot from an in-game cartoon, appeared on court.

Kotaku cites a report by Cameron Wolfe that all the Heat and Vice City gear sold out in about 90 minutes. The NBA reporter Tim Reynolds predicted that the night would set a record for merchandise sold at an NBA game; that is his prediction, not a confirmed figure.

news.name: 43 soldiers re-enlist with four days off to play
news.summary: Kotaku, citing Task & Purpose, reports that 43 soldiers of the US Army's 9th Brigade Engineer Battalion re-enlisted under an offer that included November 19 to 22 off to play the game.
body: As Kotaku reports it, the offer came from an August memo by the battalion commander and was an extra on top of existing re-enlistment bonuses, for soldiers signing on for two to six more years.
ABC News separately cites an August CBS News report on the same Army offer.

news.name: Rockstar staff vote on union recognition during launch week
news.summary: A Rockstar animation programmer wrote in The Guardian that a ballot is open for employees to decide whether their union should be recognised.
body: Nestor Uriarte, an animation programmer at Rockstar's Edinburgh studio, wrote that the ballot coincides with closing submissions in an employment tribunal over the firing of 31 union members in October 2025, which the union calls union-busting.
He writes that Rockstar says those firings were for gross misconduct unconnected with union activity, and quotes the company saying its teams have world-class work environments.
Kotaku's launch coverage reported the same vote and tribunal. No result had been reported.

news.name: Rockstar posts the Festival set times, with ticket money going to Miami charities
news.summary: Rockstar published the running order for Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival on November 21 at Mana Wynwood and said all proceeds from ticket sales will go to local Miami charities.
body: Rockstar's post on X says doors open at 4:00 p.m. and that The Store at Mana Wynwood will stock special Grand Theft Auto VI merchandise.
Rockstar says that, as a thank you to Miami, all proceeds from ticket sales will go to local Miami charities.

The schedule image Rockstar posted lists Stage One: Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso (6:00 to 7:00), Cardi B (7:45 to 8:15), Justice DJ set (9:00 to 10:00), Rauw & Friends with Tainy (11:00 to 12:00), and Cactus Jack Presents Travis Scott, Don Toliver, Kodak Black and Sofaygo (12:40 to 2:00).

The same image lists Stage Two: Suero (Jubilee b2b Berrakka b2b Jonny From Space, 4:00 to 6:00), Nick León b2b DJ Python (7:00 to 7:45), The Dare b2b Fcukers DJ set (8:15 to 9:00), Prospa b2b Skream (10:00 to 11:00) and Metro Boomin (12:00 to 12:40), plus DJ E Money inside Mana from 5:00 to 6:00 p.m.
The image names the event as presented by Rockstar Games and PlayStation.

news.name: Rockstar's launch-eve post on the PlayStation Blog
news.summary: A post by Rockstar on the PlayStation Blog the day before launch tours Leonida's regions and says on-demand podcasts are new to the series.
body: The post, signed by Rockstar's R*Q, says the game arrives on PlayStation 5 on Thursday, November 19, through the PlayStation Store.

It describes six regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga, and names Vice City areas including Ocean Beach, Little Cuba, the Tisha-Wocka flea market and VC Port, which it calls the cruise ship capital of the world.
Rockstar writes that on-demand podcasts are new for the series and can be heard in vehicles, or on foot through headphones or earbuds connected to the player's in-game phone.
The post lists radio genres including classic rock, modern hip-hop, pop, metal, dance, Latin, '80s, electronic, blues, ballads and talk radio. It gives no price, file size or sales figure.

news.name: Rockstar: PS5 Pro is not powerful enough for 60 frames per second
news.summary: Rockstar's technology production director told Kotaku that the PS5 Pro's processor cannot run the game's simulation at higher frame rates, which VGC reads as making a 60fps patch unlikely.
body: As VGC reports Marc Chambers' statement to Kotaku, the base version uses ray-traced reflections and global illumination, and PS5 Pro adds ray-traced shadows and sharper image quality through PSSR.
Chambers said the PS5 Pro's central processor is only slightly better than the base console's and not powerful enough to run the game's complex simulation at higher frame rates.
VGC says this suggests no 60fps mode is coming after launch, even on PS5 Pro. Rockstar did not say that in those words.

news.name: Digital Foundry: near-flawless on PS5 Pro, small dips on the base PS5
news.summary: VGC reports Digital Foundry found the game holds 30 frames per second almost perfectly on PS5 Pro but dips below it more often than expected on the standard PS5.
body: As VGC reports it, Digital Foundry's John Linneman said he played over 50 hours on PS5 Pro without a single performance dip outside stress tests, and the worst stress test dropped to 24 frames per second.

On the standard PS5, Linneman said the game struggles to hold 30 frames per second more often than expected, with very minor but noticeable dips such as while driving around the city, and sustained drops during heavy destruction.
Linneman also said it is smoother than any Grand Theft Auto game at launch so far. Digital Foundry called PS5 Pro the best way to play.

news.name: Rockstar's art and design leaders describe how Leonida was built
news.summary: In statements to GamesRadar+, Rockstar's vice presidents of art, design and technology said the world was made by hand and missions were built to fail the player less often.
body: Adam Cochrane, Rockstar's vice president of art and environment, told GamesRadar+ that the life is in the detail and that the whole world was curated, considered and created by a human hand.
Stephen Donkin, vice president of design, said the team worked to blur the lines between on-mission and off-mission play.

David Hynd, vice president of technology, said the team wanted to cut down on mission fails for players who experiment, and used more of the game's regular systems and AI inside missions, which he called a lot harder but worth it.
GamesRadar+'s reviewer adds that checkpoints are improved over Grand Theft Auto V and Red Dead Redemption 2, with a Retry Checkpoint option.

news.name: Analysts: cloud streaming could widen the game's Xbox audience by 30 percent
news.summary: GameSpot reports Ampere Analysis estimates that streaming to Xbox One could reach about 10 million active consoles and add 30 percent to the game's possible Xbox audience.
body: As GameSpot reports it, Ampere estimates about 10 million active Xbox One consoles and about 25 million active PS4 consoles; there is no streaming deal for PlayStation.
Ampere puts the total cost of playing through streaming at about $92, assuming the player owns an Xbox One, a copy of the game and a controller and plays for 50 hours.

Ampere suggests Take-Two may have chosen Microsoft for reach, a possible direct payment or revenue share, and Microsoft's Azure cloud capacity. It thinks a PS4 streaming deal could not come before 2027, if ever. These are the analysts' views, not company statements.
GameSpot lists the cloud playtime packs as 10 hours for $4, 25 hours for $8 and 50 hours for $12, and new monthly streaming limits of 15 hours on Game Pass Ultimate, 10 on Premium and 5 on Essential.

news.name: The tribunal over Rockstar's 2025 firings ends, awaiting a verdict
news.summary: VGC reports the employment tribunal in Glasgow over the workers Rockstar fired in 2025 has heard both sides, with a judgement expected in weeks to months.
body: VGC says the union, the IWGB, calls the firings union-busting and says the workers' outside communications were protected, while Rockstar says they were dismissed for leaking confidential information.
VGC cites Chris Bratt of People Make Games as saying the judgement could take anywhere from a few weeks to a few months.
VGC puts the number of workers at 34. The Guardian piece already in this app says 31; the two reports disagree.

news.name: A US congressman calls parents who allow the game 'bad parents'
news.summary: VGC reports Republican congressman Tim Burchett of Tennessee told reporters the game desensitises children to violence.
body: As VGC reports it, Burchett answered yes when asked whether parents who let their children play it are bad parents, but said Congress has little appetite for legislating on morality.
VGC adds that studies have largely found no link between violent video games and violent behaviour.

news.name: KFC Spain offers a disc-shaped piece of chicken for the discless box
news.summary: GameSpot reports KFC Spain will give a free disc-shaped piece of fried chicken to customers who bring their boxed copy, which contains a code and no disc.
body: As GameSpot reports it, the promotion runs December 19 and 20 from 4 to 8 p.m. at KFC restaurants in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia and other Spanish cities.
GameSpot also mentions a KFC Australia mock funeral on November 19 meant to give people a reason to take the day off, and a McDonald's delivery campaign.

news.name: Eight nominations at The Game Awards
news.summary: The Game Awards named its 2026 nominees, and Grand Theft Auto VI has eight nominations, including Game of the Year.
body: The eight, as Push Square lists them: Game of the Year, Best Game Direction, Best Narrative, Best Art Direction, Best Score and Music, Best Audio Design, Best Performance and Best Action/Adventure Game.
The Best Performance nomination is for Manni L. Perez as Lucia. The show is on December 10, 2026.

news.name: PlayStation 5 needs a system update first
news.summary: Sony's PlayStation Support account said a PlayStation 5 system software update is needed to play the game, and asked players to install it before midnight on November 19.
body: Sony did not say what the update changes. This is Kotaku's report of Sony's post.

news.name: A second update before launch
news.summary: Outlets report a second update, version 1.002.001: about 600 MB on PlayStation 5 and about 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X|S.
body: Rockstar has published no patch notes for it. The sizes come from accounts that track what consoles download, as reported by TechTimes, not from Rockstar.
Some headlines call it a day-one patch. Rockstar has not announced one.

news.name: TGG's pre-launch guide adds preview details
news.summary: The creator TGG, who watched Rockstar play the game in July, published a 55-minute guide with details not reported before.
body: New to this app from it: the four states of the criminal profile, ATMs and the three kinds of money, tools and trackers for stealing cars, garages, fuel, a handful of controls, and a story length of about 80 hours for Rob Nelson's own playthrough.

Everything from the video is labelled as a preview report. It is his account of what he saw and was told, not a Rockstar statement. He also mentions two radio stations, Vice City FM and V-Rock, that Rockstar's own music page does not list.

news.name: A first update arrives before launch
news.summary: Outlets report a mandatory update, version 1.002.000, of about 1 GB on PlayStation 5, rolling out six days before launch.
body: Rockstar has published no patch notes, so what the update changes is not known.
This comes from press reports of what consoles are downloading, not from a Rockstar announcement.

news.name: 30 frames per second, and what PS5 Pro adds
news.summary: Rockstar says the game targets 30 frames per second on both consoles. PlayStation 5 Pro adds PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows.
body: The same post says the game will be playable through Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One consoles, using Xbox Series S graphics settings, and supports Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox.
It arrived with a new video set to "Blood in Your Eyes" by Tove Lo, from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album.

news.name: Pre-load opens
news.summary: Pre-loading begins on both consoles. PlayStation 5 pre-loads opened at midnight local time, and Xbox pre-loads opened worldwide at 12 a.m. GMT. Rockstar says the download needs up to 212 GB, depending on the console.

news.name: Take-Two: development is complete
news.summary: On Take-Two's earnings call, chief executive Strauss Zelnick said Rockstar has completed development and that pre-orders are far above the company's first expectations.
body: The company gave no pre-order number. Figures quoted elsewhere are outside estimates.

news.name: Launch gallery: 39 new screenshots
news.summary: Rockstar's launch gallery adds 39 screenshots, with captions naming a Fleeca bank, The Rusty Anchor bar and Delights Cabaret.

news.name: A free poster and map of Leonida on launch day
news.summary: Rockstar will add a printable cover art poster and map of Leonida to its site as a free download on November 19.
body: A double-sided printed version follows from the Rockstar Store shortly after launch: $0.99 on its own, or free with any purchase.
The same post dated the pre-load and said code-in-box copies should reach retailers from November 12.

news.name: Original score by Justice
news.summary: Rockstar announces the 30-track score album by Justice, out December 11.

news.name: Launch Trailer
news.summary: Rockstar's final trailer before release, set to new music from Justice.
body: Rockstar's post with the trailer sums up the story: Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them, and when an easy score goes wrong they are caught in a criminal conspiracy that stretches across Leonida.

news.name: Six radio stations named
news.summary: Rockstar names six radio stations and confirms on-demand podcasts and radio on foot.
body: Radio and podcasts play in vehicles and on foot, through headphones and earbuds connected to Jason and Lucia's smartphones. Rockstar calls podcasts a first for the series.

news.name: Clothing and collectibles at the Rockstar Store
news.summary: Rockstar opens the Grand Theft Auto VI Collection at its store: tees, caps and collectibles.
body: The range includes logo tees, Goodtime State tees with characters from Macca the Gator, which Rockstar calls Leonida's hit TV show, fitted caps, a keychain, a Vice City money clip, a Zippo lighter, tote bags and stickers.
Rockstar says the Goodtime State styles are the ones Jason and Lucia wear in the Ultimate Edition.

news.name: Collector's box announced
news.summary: The Goodtime State - Vice City Collection: a $399.99 box of eleven collectibles that does not include the game.
body: Rockstar lists a 6-inch Macca the Gator figure with a stash compartment, Oakley Frogskins sunglasses, a New Era snapback hat, a Macca the Gator magnetic mirror, a swizzle spoon, a razor blade keychain, a Leonida Keys crossbody bag, a Chunkee the Manatee shot glass, an enamel pin set, stickers and a double-sided poster of the Leonida landscape.

The set takes its theme from Macca the Gator, which Rockstar describes as Leonida's hit TV show. It arrives on November 19 and is sold while supplies last. The price comes from GTA 6 Wiki, not from Rockstar's post.

news.name: The Album announced
news.summary: A 34-track official soundtrack album made with Atlantic Records, arriving with the game.

news.name: An Extended Look
news.summary: Twenty-six minutes of gameplay captured on PlayStation 5: the first sustained look at the game in motion.

news.name: Pre-orders open
news.summary: Two editions at $79.99 and $99.99, with the Vintage Vice City Pack for everyone who pre-orders.

news.name: Release moves to November 19, 2026
news.summary: Rockstar moves the game from May 26 to November 19, 2026, its second delay.

news.name: Trailer 2
news.summary: More of Jason and Lucia, and the first time six supporting characters are named.

news.name: Release set for May 26, 2026
news.summary: The original 2025 window gives way to a specific date for the first time.

news.name: Trailer 1
news.summary: The reveal: Vice City, the State of Leonida and a female lead, set to Tom Petty's "Love Is a Long Road".

faq.name: When does GTA 6 come out?
faq.summary: November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, at midnight local time in every region.
body: So it is out wherever November 19 has begun. New Zealand was first, at 11:00 UTC on November 18.
VICE reports that the digital version unlocked across the US at the same moment: 9 p.m. Pacific, 10 p.m. Mountain and 11 p.m. Central on November 18, which is midnight Eastern on November 19.

faq.name: Is GTA 6 coming to PC?
faq.summary: A PC version has not been announced. The game is announced for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
body: Still no announcement at launch. Reuters reports that Wells Fargo's sales forecast assumes a possible PC release early in 2027, and Benzinga cites an October GamesBeat report that Rockstar was aiming for the first quarter of 2027. Both are outside expectations, not dates from Rockstar.

faq.name: Where is GTA 6 set?
faq.summary: In the State of Leonida, with Vice City as its biggest city. Vice City is the series' stand-in for Miami.

faq.name: Who are the main characters?
faq.summary: Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, the two playable leads.

faq.name: Has GTA 6 been delayed?
faq.summary: Twice. A 2025 window became May 26, 2026, which then became November 19, 2026.

faq.name: How much does GTA 6 cost?
faq.summary: $79.99 for the Standard Edition and $99.99 for the Ultimate Edition.
body: Push Square reports that the free month of GTA+ included with pre-orders renews automatically at $7.99, £6.99 or €7.99 a month unless it is cancelled. On PS5 it can be cancelled under PS Store > ... > Subscriptions, and the free month stays active until it runs out.

faq.name: Can I play it on PS4 or Xbox One?
faq.summary: Not natively: the game is made for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar says it will be playable on Xbox One consoles by streaming through Xbox Cloud Gaming.
body: The cloud version uses Xbox Series S graphics settings, and Rockstar notes that connection speed can affect how it plays. PlayStation's page says the game is not playable on PlayStation 4.

faq.name: What frame rate does GTA 6 run at?
faq.summary: Rockstar says it targets 30 frames per second on both consoles.
body: On PlayStation 5 Pro it adds PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) and ray-traced shadows.

In a statement reported by VGC, Rockstar gives the resolutions: PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X upscale 1440p to 4K, PS5 Pro uses PSSR2 to upscale 1440p to 4K, and Xbox Series S upscales 720p to 1080p with AMD FSR.

Rockstar's Marc Chambers told Kotaku, as VGC reports, that the PS5 Pro's processor is not powerful enough to run the game's simulation at higher frame rates. VGC takes this to mean a 60fps patch is unlikely.
VGC reports Digital Foundry found a near-flawless 30 frames per second on PS5 Pro, small but noticeable dips on the base PS5, and frame-rate problems on Series S.

faq.name: What about GTA Online?
faq.summary: No date or detail yet. Rockstar has said the online component follows the single-player game rather than shipping with it.
body: Still no announcement at launch: the game shipped as single-player only. Benzinga cites Bloomberg as saying multiplayer is expected in 2027; Rockstar has not given a date.

faq.name: What is GTA 6 rated?
faq.summary: ESRB Mature 17+, for Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Mature Humor, Nudity, Strong Language, Strong Sexual Content, and Use of Drugs and Alcohol. The rating also notes In-Game Purchases.
body: In Japan the game is rated by CERO, whose rating does not mention the sexual content listed in most other countries. Kotaku reports that the Japanese version adds clothing to nude scenes, shows less blood, and has only English and Japanese subtitles. Rockstar had confirmed no changes before release.

faq.name: What does the PlayStation 5 version support?
faq.summary: PlayStation lists it as PS5 Pro Enhanced, with Tempest 3D Audio, fast loading from the SSD, and the DualSense controller's haptic feedback, adaptive triggers and speaker. Remote Play is supported.
body: Rockstar adds that PlayStation 5 Pro gets PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows, and that the game targets 30 frames per second. PlayStation's page also says the game is not playable on PlayStation 4.

Rockstar's statement reported by VGC says PS5 Pro upscales a 1440p base image to 4K with PSSR2, and the base PS5 upscales 1440p to 4K with Rockstar's own TAA. Rockstar's earlier post said PSSR; the statement as VGC quotes it says PSSR2.

faq.name: Can GTA 6 be played offline?
faq.summary: PlayStation's store page lists it as a one-player game with offline play enabled.

faq.name: Is there a disc version?
faq.summary: No. The boxed Standard Edition holds a download code and no disc, and there is no boxed Ultimate Edition.
body: PlayStation codes work only on accounts in the region group they were sold for, so Rockstar recommends buying in the country of your platform account. Xbox codes are not region-locked.
In Japan, codes expire 170 days after launch day.
GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen told Bloomberg on launch day that the move to all-digital has hurt consumers and GameStop, though he said the store is selling a lot of the boxed code edition.

faq.name: Who plays Jason and Lucia?
faq.summary: Rockstar's official credits list Dylan Rourke as Jason Duval and Manni L. Perez as Lucia Caminos.
body: Perez's casting became public when she was nominated for Best Performance at The Game Awards on November 17, as Video Games Chronicle reported. Vice notes that Rockstar itself has not commented.
Stephen Root told the Associated Press in September that he is in the game, as Variety reported. Outlets identify his character as Brian Heder; Root did not name it.
Rockstar's official credits, published on November 19, list Dylan Rourke as Jason Duval and Manni L. Perez as Lucia Caminos.

The same cast list confirms Stephen Root as Brian Heder. It also names, among others, Bobby Moynihan as Cal, Mike Forbs as Boobie Ike, Naiqui Macabroad as Dre'Quan, Hood Brat as Bae-Luxe, Krissy Celess as Roxy Rashad and Manny Perez as Raul Bautista.
IGN reports that a photo of Rourke and Perez with Lucia's stunt double Victoria Lee appeared on Lee's Instagram the same day.

faq.name: Who made GTA 6?
faq.summary: Rockstar Games developed and published it. Rockstar North's co-studio head Rob Nelson is listed as producer, and Justice composed the score.
body: Wikipedia's article lists Stephen Donkin as designer, Jonathon Ashcroft as programmer, Aaron Garbut as artist, and four writers: Rupert Humphries, Alexa D'Agostino, Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern and Michael Wiafe.
These come from Wikipedia's summary, not from the game's own credits, which no site had transcribed when this was written.

Rockstar has now published the full credits at rockstargames.com/VI/credits, so this no longer rests on Wikipedia. The top of the list: Sam Houser (Founder, Executive Producer), Jennifer Kolbe (Head of Publishing), Rob Nelson and Aaron Garbut (Head of Development / Co-Studio Head), Phil Hooker (Head of Development) and Chris Choi (Senior Vice President of Development).

Department heads in the credits include Rupert Humphries (Narrative), Stephen Donkin (Design), Jonathon Ashcroft (Technology), Alastair MacGregor (Audio) and Jeff Rosa (Quality Assurance). The writers listed under Narrative are Alexa D'Agostino, Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern and Michael Wiafe, and DJ Pooh and Joey Henson lead the TV and radio writing.

faq.name: It won't download or start on PlayStation 5. What now?
faq.summary: PlayStation's support page says to pause and resume the download first, then cancel, delete and download it again from your Game Library.
body: It also says to check PlayStation's status page for outages, update the system software, make sure there is enough free storage, and as a last step start the console in Safe Mode and choose Clear Cache and Rebuild Database.

If the game will not start on an account that did not buy it, the buyer's account needs Console Sharing and Offline Play switched on for that console. Restoring licences (Settings, Users and Accounts, Other) is the other fix it gives.

The same page confirms that the Vintage Vice City Pack's '55 Vapid Stanier is kept in the Shore Court garage at Ocean Beach, which has a weapon locker and a place to fence stolen goods, and that the Ultimate Edition's extras unlock chapter by chapter.

On November 18 GamesRadar+ reported that some PS5 players, including its own UK writers, had trouble redeeming codes and upgrading editions, with Downdetector showing a spike from about 1 p.m. Eastern. PlayStation's status page showed no fault, and retrying worked for its writer.

faq.name: How long is GTA 6?
faq.summary: Reviewers put the main story at about 60 hours.
body: Push Square's reviewer estimates about 80 hours for an average player who also does side content, and 300 hours or more to complete everything. TheSixthAxis's reviewer took more than 60 hours for the story and many side missions.
These are two reviewers' own playthroughs, not a figure from Rockstar.

faq.name: What did the reviews say?
faq.summary: Metacritic shows 99 from 147 PlayStation 5 reviews as of November 18, with none mixed or negative.
body: The number will move as more reviews are added. Of the two reviews read in full for this app, TheSixthAxis gave 9 out of 10 and Push Square 10 out of 10.

VGC reported on November 18 that the game had become number one on Metacritic's list of the best games of all time. It is tied at 99 with the original Nintendo 64 Ocarina of Time but ranked above it by Metacritic's more precise calculation. At the time VGC wrote, the PlayStation 5 score came from 109 reviews.

Take-Two's launch press release of November 19 calls it the highest rated game of all time on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. IGN points out that across all platforms it shares the top Metacritic score of 99 with the Nintendo 64 Ocarina of Time.
